title: Developing Skills in Non-Invasive History Taking as an Aspiring Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚取金钱之外的收益，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年参加过这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，且无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场团体智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森的精美礼品，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多详情，请点击简介中我的福利页面链接。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，就让这本书成为你的指引吧。

sentences.en: I do beyond your wish.
sentences.zh: 我做的超乎你的期望。

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist Podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 《有志心理学家播客》，我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Hey, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嘿，欢迎收听《有志心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: And today we're doing a special requeSt.
sentences.zh: 今天我们要应听众要求做一个特别节目。

sentences.en: So thank you for everyone who's been in contact and saying really lovely things about the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢所有与我们联系并对本播客给予高度评价的朋友。

sentences.en: Thank you for subscribing and sharing it with your network.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们的订阅，并将其分享给你们的朋友圈。

sentences.en: It is so greatly appreciated.
sentences.zh: 对此我们不胜感激。

sentences.en: Today I'm going to be thinking with you about history taking in a way that doesn't just feel
sentences.zh: 今天我想和大家探讨一下病史采集的方法，这种方法不会让人感觉

sentences.en: like an onslaught and doesn't feel like it's just really hard work for you and really invasive for the client that you're spending time with.
sentences.zh: 像是一场狂轰滥炸，也不会让你觉得工作异常繁重，同时对你陪伴的客户来说也不会显得过分侵入。

sentences.en: So yeah, let me see how well I can do this on an audio podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧，让我看看在一档音频播客里我能把这个讲得有多好。

sentences.en: I feel like it might be a little bit better presented with a PowerPoint or a Canva or something, but I will try and use my very best at describing ways for you.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果配合PPT、Canva或其他视觉工具可能会呈现得更好一些，但我会尽我最大的努力向大家描述各种方法。

sentences.en: Now, let's also just think about which discipline of psychology you are going to be striving for.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们也来思考一下你打算追求哪个心理学分支。

sentences.en: I believe that good history taking is appropriate to all disciplines, be that clinical or counselling, forensic, health, counselling, education, you know, the world is your oyster.
sentences.zh: 我相信优秀的病史采集适用于所有心理学分支，无论是临床心理学、咨询心理学、法医心理学、健康心理学、教育心理学，你知道的，海阔凭鱼跃。

sentences.en: But I think that a really good history taking in a way that does feel human is so important.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，以一种具有人情味的方式进行非常出色的病史采集是极其重要的。

sentences.en: So I really like this question because it shows us the attunement and being on board with how it feels for a client.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很喜欢这个问题，因为它展现了我们的共情能力以及对客户真实感受的理解。

sentences.en: And this is absolutely something that I have gone through myself as well in my kind of metamorphosis, shall we say, as a developing clinician, because we're always developing.
sentences.zh: 这绝对也是我自己作为一个不断成长的临床医生，在经历所谓的“蜕变”时亲身经历过的，因为我们一直在成长。

sentences.en: There's always better and different ways to do things.
sentences.zh: 总会有更好、不同的做事方法。

sentences.en: Every day is a school day and we're never going to be complete.
sentences.zh: 活到老学到老，我们永远不会完美。

sentences.en: You know, we can always change and adapt and grow and, you know, hear really great ways of doing things and think, I am having that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们总是可以改变、适应和成长，听到非常棒的做事方法时会想：“这个我收下了。”

sentences.en: But don't let that be daunting, though, because we do learn to be good enough.
sentences.zh: 但不要因此感到畏惧，因为我们都在努力变得足够优秀。

sentences.en: But, you know, when you work in this mental health field and you see practice that really connects with you,
sentences.zh: 不过，当你在这个心理健康领域工作，看到真正能引起你共鸣的实践时，

sentences.en: it's OK to borrow that and to kind of bring that into your fold of the way that you work and the way that you aspire to be with people.
sentences.zh: 你可以去借鉴它，并把它融入你自己的工作方式中，融入你期望与他人相处的方式中。

sentences.en: It might be just worth telling you that in my private practice, what I do in terms of outcome measures is I send those in advance of the appointment.
sentences.zh: 或许值得一提的是，在我的私人诊所里，关于结果评估量表，我通常在预约前就发给客户。

sentences.en: I use a clinical note system called WriteUp, but it might be that whichever organisation you work in, there's also some sort of electronic form giving capacity.
sentences.zh: 我使用的是一个名为WriteUp的临床笔记系统，不过无论你在哪个机构工作，可能也都有某种电子表单发放功能。

sentences.en: So it means you can send those questionnaires in advance and then have the person send them back to you before the appointment.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你可以提前把这些问卷发过去，让对方在预约前填写完毕并回传给你。

sentences.en: And why I like that, because it allows me to screen for risk, you know, as a rudimentary measure and to look at, you know, look at getting those scored ahead of the session
sentences.zh: 我之所以喜欢这样做，是因为它能让我作为一项基础措施来筛查风险，并提前将这些问卷评分查阅完毕，

sentences.en: and my virtual assistant will pop them into a whizzy spreadsheet for me and it also automatically creates graphs.
sentences.zh: 我的虚拟助理会把它们导入一个酷炫的电子表格中，它还能自动生成图表。

sentences.en: So at the assessment, I can show these graphs to the person and we can talk them through together.
sentences.zh: 因此在评估时，我可以把这些图表展示给对方，我们可以一起讨论。

sentences.en: But maybe, you know, if it's at all possible in your job plan, even if there are paper questionnaires,
sentences.zh: 但也许，如果你的工作安排允许的话，即使使用的是纸质问卷，

sentences.en: whether you've perhaps got a junior member of the team who could phone the client in advance
sentences.zh: 无论你是否有一位可以提前给客户打电话的初级团队成员，

sentences.en: and do those questionnaires with the client so that you're using your time together with the client optimally.
sentences.zh: 由他们协助客户完成这些问卷，这样你就能最优化地利用与客户在一起的时间。

sentences.en: Though, of course, it can be a bit tricky because, you know, people don't always attend appointments.
sentences.zh: 当然，这有时也有点棘手，因为人们并不总是按时赴约。

sentences.en: You might have had a DNA and you'd have this data then that relates to the patient and they haven't shown up.
sentences.zh: 你可能会遇到爽约（DNA）的情况，而你手里却握着患者的数据，但他们根本没来。

sentences.en: But there's always ways for thinking about how you can get that data without you having to use your valuable clinical time with people to read those questionnaires
sentences.zh: 不过总有办法去思考如何在不占用你宝贵的临床时间去阅读那些问卷的情况下获取这些数据，

sentences.en: because actually, that's what I hate.
sentences.zh: 因为说实话，那正是我讨厌的。

sentences.en: People don't like it very much either.
sentences.zh: 客户其实也不太喜欢这样。

sentences.en: I'm a skilled clinician and I'm sure you are too.
sentences.zh: 我是一名熟练的临床医生，相信你也是。

sentences.en: And actually, it's just not good use of my time or the client's time to have me read all those questions aloud.
sentences.zh: 事实上，让我把所有这些问题大声朗读出来，并不是对我或客户时间的有效利用。

sentences.en: But whether, you know, they might want to get there early to do those questionnaires, so maybe you can give them an earlier time.
sentences.zh: 不过，也许他们愿意早点来做这些问卷，所以你可以给他们安排一个更早的时间。

sentences.en: But of course, if the client is having to do those on that day, then it might take them outside of their window of tolerance too.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果客户必须在当天现场填写，那也可能会超出他们的耐受窗口。

sentences.en: So it's thinking about the best way of doing that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要思考这样做的最佳方式。

sentences.en: But in terms of the actual session content for history taking and for initial assessments,
sentences.zh: 但就病史采集和初始评估的实际会话内容而言，

sentences.en: I'll take you through the approach that I use.
sentences.zh: 我将带大家了解我所使用的方法。

sentences.en: So I don't actually use pre-filled or pre-formatted forMs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我并不使用预先填好或格式化的表格。

sentences.en: I like to go a bit old school.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢稍微复古一点的方式。

sentences.en: I like a bit of A3 paper.
sentences.zh: 我偏爱A3纸。

sentences.en: So I like to, for each client that I assess and each that I treat, I like to have this A3 piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于我评估和治疗的每一位客户，我都喜欢准备这样一张A3纸。

sentences.en: And when I'm with them, I go through, you know, what gender they see themselves as.
sentences.zh: 当我和他们在一起时，我会探讨他们的自我认同性别。

sentences.en: And so I draw the appropriate shape, either a circle or a square.
sentences.zh: 然后我会画出相应的形状，圆形或正方形。

sentences.en: And I think the non-binary shape is a diamond, but I might be wrong.
sentences.zh: 我记得非二元性别的形状是菱形，不过我可能记错了。

sentences.en: Let me know if I am.
sentences.zh: 如果我记错了，请告诉我。

sentences.en: So I would draw that and I draw that in the middle of the page.
sentences.zh: 我会把这个形状画在纸的中间。

sentences.en: I'd put their name and their age in the shape too.
sentences.zh: 我也会把他们的名字和年龄写在形状里面。

sentences.en: And I'd be thinking with them about people in their family.
sentences.zh: 我会和他们一起探讨他们家庭中的成员。

sentences.en: So just looking really to draw a basic family tree.
sentences.zh: 也就是着手绘制一个基本的家谱。

sentences.en: And as I'm just doing that on my lap, people are talking.
sentences.zh: 当我正把着膝盖画这些的时候，客户在说话。

sentences.en: And at the beginning of the session, I would explain to the client that I'm with that I'll be making some notes as we talk.
sentences.zh: 在会话开始时，我会向眼前的客户解释，我们交谈时我会做一些记录。

sentences.en: And it's just to help me remember, because actually, as a result of today,
sentences.zh: 这只是为了帮我记忆，因为事实上，在今天会话结束后，

sentences.en: I'm going to be writing a report, an assessment report.
sentences.zh: 我要写一份报告，一份评估报告。

sentences.en: And I want to make sure that I'm remembering it well enough.
sentences.zh: 我想确保自己能把这些内容记清楚。

sentences.en: But I'll be doing it in such a way that if you want to know what I'm writing at any point, please do just let me know.
sentences.zh: 但我的记录方式是，如果你在任何时候想知道我在写什么，请随时告诉我。

sentences.en: And I'm not writing big things.
sentences.zh: 我写的不是什么长篇大论。

sentences.en: I'm just writing notes to help me remember.
sentences.zh: 我只是写点笔记来帮助自己记忆。

sentences.en: But please, if you did want to ask at any point, or you wondered what I was writing or why I'd written it,
sentences.zh: 但请记住，如果你在任何时候想问，或者好奇我在写什么以及为什么要写，

sentences.en: I'm really okay with it being a transparent process.
sentences.zh: 我非常赞成将这个过程公开透明化。

sentences.en: So please do feel free to ask.
sentences.zh: 所以请尽管开口询问。

sentences.en: So once I'm padding out my family tree,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我逐步完善家谱时，

sentences.en: I'm looking to work out if their parents are still alive, if they've got any siblings, if their grandparents are alive, if there've been any significant bereavements,
sentences.zh: 我会去了解他们的父母是否健在、是否有兄弟姐妹、祖父母是否健在、是否有过重大的丧亲经历，

sentences.en: and who they feel closest to, if anyone.
sentences.zh: 以及他们觉得和谁最亲近（如果有的话）。

sentences.en: And also, it's always really important to ask about any pets, or any really important friends, or aunts, or uncles, people that are kind of on their team,
sentences.zh: 同样，询问是否有宠物，或者任何非常重要的朋友、阿姨、叔叔，也就是那些像是站在他们这一边、

sentences.en: that feel like they're on their page.
sentences.zh: 和他们心意相通的人，这也总是非常重要的。

sentences.en: And people often don't expect you to be asking these questions, and often asking about strengths too, things that are going well in their lives.
sentences.zh: 人们通常不会期望你问这些问题，同时问及他们的长处以及他们生活中进展顺利的事情也同样重要。

sentences.en: And I'd usually follow the same pattern.
sentences.zh: 我通常会遵循相同的模式。

sentences.en: So the top left of my document would be my kind of problem-focused section.
sentences.zh: 所以我文档的左上角将是我的“以问题为中心”的部分。

sentences.en: And it usually crops up in conversation.
sentences.zh: 这通常会在对话中自然浮现。

sentences.en: I might say to them, so, you know, what brought you here today?
sentences.zh: 我可能会对他们说：“那么，是什么把你带到这里来的呢？”

sentences.en: Because I often don't know anything about clients before I meet them.
sentences.zh: 因为在见到客户之前，我通常对他们一无所知。

sentences.en: And even when I was in the NHS service, I sometimes wouldn't want to read too much about clients.
sentences.zh: 甚至当我还在英国国民医疗服务体系（NHS）工作时，有时我也不想阅读太多关于客户的背景资料。

sentences.en: So I knew they'd been through the triage process, and they were deemed as being likely to benefit from a psychology assessment.
sentences.zh: 我只知道他们已经通过了分类评估流程，并且被认为很可能会从心理学评估中受益。

sentences.en: But I like to hear from clients at the time that the client tells me, which could also, I guess, be a bit frustrating for clients too, because they're like,
sentences.zh: 但我更喜欢在客户亲自讲述时倾听，这其实也可能会让客户感到有点沮丧，因为他们会觉得：

sentences.en: oh no, I've already told someone all of this.
sentences.zh: “天哪，我已经把这些都告诉过别人了。”

sentences.en: I was hoping you'd know already.
sentences.zh: “我本以为你已经知道了。”

sentences.en: But yeah, I think there is value in giving people the experience to tell you things themselves.
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，我认为让人们亲口向你诉说这些经历是有价值的。

sentences.en: So I've been looking at the problems and also thinking about the goals.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在关注问题，同时也在思考目标。

sentences.en: Goals would usually be top right for me, what they're aiming to get out of therapy or treatment, what would feel useful, and the strengths is between those two.
sentences.zh: 目标对我来说通常在右上角，也就是他们希望从治疗或干预中获得什么、什么会让他们觉得有帮助，而长处则介于这两者之间。

sentences.en: So if we're looking at my piece of A3, we've got problems on the left, top right is goals, and then next to goals, I would have strengths.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们看我的A3纸，左边是问题，右上角是目标，然后在目标旁边就是长处。

sentences.en: Next along from that to the left, there'd be medication, and also a column for self-soothing.
sentences.zh: 再往左一点，会是药物治疗，还有一个用于自我抚慰的栏目。

sentences.en: So that might be really adaptive things like going for a walk or some yoga or mindfulness or meditation, but it might also include slightly less adaptive techniques
sentences.zh: 这可能包括非常具有适应性的活动，比如散步、瑜伽、正念或冥想，但它也可能包括适应性稍差的技术，

sentences.en: like smoking, alcohol, or self-harm.
sentences.zh: 比如抽烟、喝酒或自残。

sentences.en: It's whatever helps them get through each day currently.
sentences.zh: 无论是什么，只要能帮助他们撑过每一天就行。

sentences.en: But of course, you know,
sentences.zh: 当然，

sentences.en: I'm exploring these in a way that feels non-judgmental.
sentences.zh: 我以一种不带评判色彩的方式来探索这些。

sentences.en: So absolutely going with the stance that there's no judgment here.
sentences.zh: 绝对要秉持这里没有评判的立场。

sentences.en: And actually we understand these methods as just being able to get through each day the best we can with the resources we've got.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们理解这些方法只是为了利用现有的资源，尽最大努力度过每一天。

sentences.en: And on some days we might have more resources or we might be better resourced than other days.
sentences.zh: 有时我们可能拥有更多资源，或者比其他日子拥有更好的资源储备。

sentences.en: And just trying to explore with them, really thinking about that window of tolerance and trying to think about ways we might be able to help them thicken
sentences.zh: 并尝试与他们一起探索，真正去思考那个耐受窗口，并设法找到能够帮助他们加厚

sentences.en: and broaden that window of tolerance.
sentences.zh: 和拓宽耐受窗口的方法。

sentences.en: Let's think some more about this assessment and history-taking after this brief advert.
sentences.zh: 在简短的广告之后，让我们继续探讨这个评估和病史采集的话题。

sentences.en: You know, I love the Grief Collective book.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我非常喜欢《悲伤合集》这本书。

sentences.en: It really helped me to realise that what I've been going through with grief is entirely normal.
sentences.zh: 它真的帮我意识到，我所经历的悲伤完全是正常的。

sentences.en: I love being part of the collective.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能成为这个集体的一员。

sentences.en: Whilst I read the book, and it was such a privilege to have such intimate access into people's lives, thoughts, and feelings, I would recommend it to anyone
sentences.zh: 当我阅读这本书时，能如此深入地了解人们的生活、思想和感受是一种特权，我会把它推荐给任何

sentences.en: wanting to understand themselves or someone they care about.
sentences.zh: 想要了解自己或自己关心的人的读者。

sentences.en: Okay, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 好了，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: So what we are doing is we're building up a picture of the difficulties that the person has had and then their relationship to those difficulties.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在在做的是，构建一幅图景，展现此人曾经遇到的困难，以及他们与这些困难的关系。

sentences.en: I'd also have a section for thinking about previously tried, you know, therapies or psychology input.
sentences.zh: 我还会设置一个板块，用来思考以前尝试过的疗法或心理学干预。

sentences.en: So if they've already had a year of counselling or 20 sessions of CBT, then I'll be putting that down as well.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果他们已经接受了一年的咨询或者20次认知行为疗法（CBT），我也会把这些记录下来。

sentences.en: I'd also be asking them about their opinion for how it went and whether it's informed their choice for a future therapy,
sentences.zh: 我还会询问他们对这些疗法效果的看法，以及这是否影响了他们对未来治疗的选择，

sentences.en: you know, a future whatever, whatever we've got on, whatever you're assessing for.
sentences.zh: 无论是未来的某种疗法，还是你正在评估的任何其他项目。

sentences.en: And I would also have a section for ideas.
sentences.zh: 我还会设立一个“想法”板块。

sentences.en: So as we're talking, I might scribble down an idea.
sentences.zh: 因此，在交谈过程中，我可能会随手记下一个想法。

sentences.en: For example, if I notice they're being really harsh on themselves, then I'd likely scribble down a CFT book
sentences.zh: 例如，如果我注意到他们对自我非常严苛，我可能会随手写下一本聚焦慈悲心疗法（CFT）的书

sentences.en: or, you know, a group that we might have running.
sentences.zh: 或者我们可能正在开办的一个互助小组。

sentences.en: So this is when I come to summarise at the end of our session that I've already got, you know, my informed thinking about what I think might be a reasonable plan
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么当我在会话结束时进行总结时，我已经有了经过深思熟虑的想法，认为什么可能是一个合理的计划，

sentences.en: so that we're able to send them away with a plan that feels helpful.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就能让他们带着一个感觉有帮助的计划离开。

sentences.en: Of course, risk is key.
sentences.zh: 当然，风险评估是关键。

sentences.en: But if you've covered the questionnaire and the things beforehand, then you'd have an idea of risk too.
sentences.zh: 但如果你之前已经完成了问卷和相关事项，那么你对风险也会有所了解。

sentences.en: But in terms of coping strategies, risk often comes up too.
sentences.zh: 不过就应对策略而言，风险问题也经常会出现。

sentences.en: So this is, you know, I hope a useful approach for you.
sentences.zh: 所以，希望这对你来说是一种有用方法。

sentences.en: And obviously you need to adhere to whatever your service is asking you to do.
sentences.zh: 显然，你需要遵循你所在服务机构的要求。

sentences.en: If you've got certain hoops, then you're going to need to make sure you're jumping through those in regard to what questions and boxes need ticking and fulfilling whatever
sentences.zh: 如果你必须通过某些考核环节，那么你需要确保自己满足这些要求，回答相应的问题并勾选所需的方框，以履行

sentences.en: you've been asked to achieve,
sentences.zh: 你被要求达到的目标，

sentences.en: you know, for what your service is funded to strive for.
sentences.zh: 也就是你所在的机构获得资助所要追求的方向。

sentences.en: So I think doing that sensitively and being transparent about that with the client is really helpful.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为以敏感的方式做到这一点，并对客户保持透明是非常有帮助的。

sentences.en: And the way that I would do that is I'm really sorry.
sentences.zh: 我通常会这样处理：“非常抱歉。”

sentences.en: I know this can feel like a bit of a deluge of questions and it can.
sentences.zh: “我知道这可能会让人觉得问题铺天盖地，确实如此。”

sentences.en: I know people have told me it can feel a little bit intrusive.
sentences.zh: “我知道有人跟我说过，这可能会让人觉得有点侵犯隐私。”

sentences.en: But the way we're funded and the way that we have to keep our records means that I need to ask everybody the same questions.
sentences.zh: “但我们的资助方式以及我们必须保存记录的方式意味着我需要问每个人相同的问题。”

sentences.en: And so that's how I'd handle it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我处理这件事的方式。

sentences.en: But if you've got any other questions about how to do this,
sentences.zh: 如果你对如何做到这一点还有其他任何问题，

sentences.en: I'd be really happy to answer them and to think with you again about the way we can do this in a way that feels like you're on the same page as the client and not kind of
sentences.zh: 我非常乐意回答，并和你一起探讨如何以一种让客户觉得你们站在同一阵线，而不是

sentences.en: on an opposing team, not just like you're hiding behind a clipboard, because I think that can feel really challenging both for you and for the clients that you're working with.
sentences.zh: 站在对立面的方式来开展工作，不要表现得好像躲在文件夹后面一样，因为我认为这无论对你还是对你共事的客户来说都极具挑战性。

sentences.en: So it's just brought to mind for me something that we call the single session intervention.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一个我们称之为“单次干预”的概念。

sentences.en: So I don't tend to do assessments just for assessment's sake, but I'd often use aspects from the Our Tricky Brain Kit, which you can find out more information about on my website
sentences.zh: 因此，我一般不会为了评估而评估，但我经常会运用“我们的棘手大脑工具包”中的元素，你可以在我的网站

sentences.en: or in the show notes to help clients to understand why they feel the way they feel and to think with them about useful stuff that they can take away from the session.
sentences.zh: 或节目简介中找到更多相关信息，以帮助客户理解他们为什么会有这种感觉，并与他们探讨他们可以从会话中带走的实用内容。

sentences.en: So I might teach them a breathing technique or think with them about the window of tolerance, stuff that they can actually, you know, leave our session feeling like they're
sentences.zh: 所以我可能会教他们一种呼吸技巧，或者和他们一起探讨耐受窗口，让他们在离开我们的会话时真正感觉到

sentences.en: in a better, a stronger position than they were when they entered the building, because often even to get to a psychology assessment, you've already had to perhaps
sentences.zh: 处于比刚进大楼时更好、更强大的状态，因为通常甚至在进行心理评估之前，你可能已经

sentences.en: have a team assessment or some other kind of assessment from a triage service.
sentences.zh: 接受过团队评估或分诊服务的其他某种评估。

sentences.en: You might already have had a long wait and you might have an even longer wait to come or it might be that you don't actually meet the criteria for intervention.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经经历了一次漫长的等待，而且可能还要面对更长的等待，或者事实证明你其实并不符合干预的标准。

sentences.en: So isn't it great that if you've got, you know, an ability to feel better from, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你能通过，你知道的，与某人相处 60 到 90 分钟而感觉好点，你知道的，

sentences.en: 60 to 90 minutes with someone, that's a really special chance that we get with people to get it right.
sentences.zh: 这真的是我们与人们接触并做对事情的一个非常特别的机会。

sentences.en: So it might feel like you've already said everything that feels pertinent and you might not want to be saying it all again.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可能会觉得你已经说完了所有相关的事情，并且你可能不想把所有事情再说一遍。

sentences.en: So whether you can use your history taking your assessment session to test out actually how able and capable they are to access the kind of stuff that you'd be having on offer
sentences.zh: 因此，无论你是否可以利用病史采集和评估会话来实际测试他们获取你将要提供的各类内容的27能力，

sentences.en: when they actually started to receive the services from you or your service.
sentences.zh: 当他们真正开始接受你或你所在服务机构的服务时。

sentences.en: So if you're trying to do loads of breathing with them or distress tolerance or mindfulness and they just can't do it, they don't get it, then actually it's maybe an indication
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你试图和他们一起做大量的呼吸训练、痛苦耐受或正念，而他们根本做不到，无法理解，那么这实际上可能是一个迹象

sentences.en: that maybe your service isn't going to meet their needs in the way that might be optimal for them at this time.
sentences.zh: 表明你的服务可能无法以此时对他们最理想的方式满足他们的需求。

sentences.en: So I hope this will be useful and if it is, please do rate and review and subscribe and I will look forward to catching up with you on our next podcast episode very soon.
sentences.zh: 因此，我希望这会有所帮助，如果确实如此，请务必进行评分、评论和订阅，我期待在我们的下一期播客节目中很快与大家见面。

sentences.en: Take care of you.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能赚取超越时间变现的收入会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist and I've been developing and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自 2019 年以来我一直在开发被动和循环收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励以及我自己的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四个小组大师班、大师讲座、个性化指导、一份福特南梅森美食礼品以及限时一对一教练指导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何疑问，我随时都在。
